data.name: Liquid Trees
data.description: Liquid Trees is a seed-stage CDR company founded in 2022 by Daniel Neetzel, headquartered in San Francisco with operations in India, backed by Unruly Capital. It evolved from diatom-led freshwater bioremediation projects into ocean iron fertilization research, and partnered with India's DS Group to deploy an urban microalgae photobioreactor in Noida.
